name: slider
title: Slider
description: Picks a number or a range by dragging or with the keyboard, with a formatted value next to the label.

examples.name: slider-range
examples.title: Range
examples.description: Two thumbs with their own accessible names; the output uses a formatted range.

examples.name: slider-formatted
examples.title: Formatted values
examples.description: Percent and unit formatting via formatOptions.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without one, pass aria-label.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: One number for a single thumb, [min, max] for a range.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Formats the output and the announced value (currency, percent, units).

props.name: showOutput
props.description: Show the formatted value next to the label.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names for each thumb of a range, e.g. ['Minimum', 'Maximum']; combined with the label.

keyboard.action: Increases by one step (Arrow Left increases in right-to-left locales).

notes: Each thumb is a native range input, announced with the formatted value.
Give range thumbs distinct names with thumbLabels.
Direction follows the React Aria locale (I18nProvider); set a right-to-left locale for Arabic or Hebrew interfaces, not only dir="rtl".
The track is a 24px-tall target even though the rail is thin.

do: Use when an approximate value is fine and the range is small.
Show the value with formatOptions so people don't have to guess.
dont: Don't use a slider for precise entry like amounts to the rupee; use a TextField.
Don't use a range slider without naming both thumbs.
